features: 8-in-1 Multipurpose Design Simplify your everyday carry with the Snapcase Ultra, an all-in-one connectivity kit featuring a Type-C cable, USB-A adapter, 8-pin adapter, Micro USB adapter, SIM card slots, a Micro SD card holder, and a SIM ejector pin.
60W PD Fast Charging Power up your smartphones, tablets, power banks, earbuds, and other compatible devices with up to 60W high-speed charging support.
High-Speed Data Transfer Transfer photos, videos, documents, music, and other files quickly and efficiently while charging your devices simultaneously.
Universal Device Compatibility Designed to work seamlessly with USB-A, Type-C, Lightning (8-pin), and Micro USB devices, making it an ideal companion for work, travel, and everyday use.
Built-In Storage Compartments Keep your Nano SIM cards, Micro SD cards, adapters, and SIM ejector pin neatly organized and easily accessible wherever you go.
Compact & Travel-Friendly Design Its lightweight, pocket-sized design with an integrated carrying loop makes Snapcase Ultra easy to carry in your pocket, backpack, laptop bag, or travel pouch.
description: The Portronics Snapcase Ultra is a compact 8-in-1 connectivity solution designed to keep all your essential adapters and accessories in one convenient place. Equipped with a Type-C cable, USB-A, 8-pin, and Micro USB connectors, along with dedicated storage for Nano SIM cards, Micro SD cards, and a SIM ejector pin, it eliminates the hassle of carrying multiple accessories. Supporting up to 60W PD fast charging and high-speed data transfer, Snapcase Ultra is built for modern lifestyles. Whether you're travelling, working remotely, or simply managing multiple devices, its portable design ensures that charging, data transfer, and storage are always within reach.
